name: Nuremberg
registryBasis: The Nuremberg Office for Geoinformation and Land Management offers official cadastral maps and lists ALKIS WMS/WFS services. Bavaria’s official ALKIS WFS contains parcel features (ave:Flurstueck) and is expressly an owner-excluded schema, but the service is limited to public-sector framework-contract customers and requires authentication; the WFS was not queried. The free ALKIS Parzellarkarte WMS is a raster image display, omits parcel numbers and does not return full polygon geometry.
